name: EURETILE D7.3 Dynamic DAL benchmarks
description:
The EURETILE project required the selection and coding of a set of dedicated
benchmarks. The project is about the software and hardware architecture of
future many-tile distributed fault-tolerant systems. We focus on dynamic
workloads characterised by heavy numerical processing requirements. The
ambition is to identify common techniques that could be applied to both the
Embedded Systems and HPC domains. This document is the first public deliverable
of Work Package 7: Challenging Tiled Applications.
domain: embedded systems / high-performance computing (many-tile distributed systems)
evaluation_method: performance metrics (execution time, throughput, scalability, efficiency, resource utilization, energy consumption)
general_score_metric: execution time / throughput / scalability (depending on workload)
reputation: Project-specific EU research benchmark suite used in the EURETILE community and related HPC/embedded-systems research; limited broader community adoption outside the project and affiliated labs.
notes: Benchmarks are hardware- and software-stack sensitive (results not portable across architectures); focused on many-tile distributed systems with heavy numerical workloads; reproducibility depends on available hardware; not an LLM benchmark and may become outdated as architectures evolve.
